notes: Second-generation K8B capture (2026-05-27) with upgraded antenna setup at the same Sinnonhyeon location. New antenna: significantly improved over the 41 cm 1/4-λ monopole used for k8b_rust and the moderate setup used for k8b_strong, but still no LNA. Captured both raw I/Q (k8b_v2.iq, 240 MB) and an ETI file from eti-cmdline-airspy LIVE (k8b_v2.eti, 12.8 MB, 2088 frames). The live ETI is the better of the two (int16 native precision throughout the OFDM chain, no cu8 quantization loss). Multi-channel scan confirms K8B is the only K-block ensemble within reception threshold at this site/antenna combination — K12A/B/C (MBC DMB / U-KBS / SBS u) all report 'no DAB signal here', consistent with K8B (YTN) being the strongest Korean DMB transmitter from Namsan + 4 SFN sites. FIB pass rate 43.96% (3672/8352), well above k8b_strong's 11% but still below k8b_100pct's 75%. RS chain aligns at phase 196 but corrects 0/10796 blocks — BER still exceeds t=8 limit, meaning end-to-end video decode (MP4) is not yet achievable. Need ~3 dB more SNR for that (LNA addition or move to outdoor / window line-of-sight to Namsan). For dab-rs purposes: this is now the best OFDM/inner-FEC oracle (better than k8b_strong), with the bonus that all 5 services are correctly identified and an eti-stuff ETI ground-truth exists.

environment.antenna: DIY half-wave dipole — 41 cm × 2 enameled-wire arms (total 82 cm), fed via ~1 m Teflon-insulated twisted-pair feedline (no coax), connected via reused SMA male base from a sacrificed rubber-duck WiFi antenna. Horizontal polarization. Indoor interior position (NOT at window — that comes in k8b_v3 onwards). No LNA.
environment.location: Sinnonhyeon (신논현), Seocho-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea — indoor (interior, not at window)

channel_scan_results.K12A: ✗ no DAB signal here (MBC DMB out of range)
channel_scan_results.K12B: ✗ no DAB signal here (U-KBS out of range)
channel_scan_results.K12C: ✗ no DAB signal here (SBS u out of range)
channel_scan_results.note: K-block scan: only K8B receivable at current setup. K12 family ~3 dB weaker per PSD probe (rms 14 dB vs K8B 17 dB); antenna or EIRP frequency-dependent. Suggests antenna gain pattern favors lower VHF (183 MHz) over upper VHF (205-209 MHz).

raw_iq_capture.notes: Captured first, before the live eti-cmdline-airspy run. Suitable for dab-rs OFDM Stage 1-7 validation.

live_eti_capture.notes: Captured immediately after the raw I/Q with the same RF setup. This is the eti-stuff ground-truth ETI for cross-validation against dab-rs Stage 1-7 output.

outer_rs_decode_on_live_eti.verdict: FAIL — BER exceeds t=8 RS correction limit on every block. Not video-decode quality. Need ~3 dB more SNR via LNA or outdoor placement.
